facts.fact: The ordonnance-loi of 13 March 2023 (Code du Numérique) governs electronic writings, electronic signatures (qualified signature has the evidential force of a handwritten one, Art. 108), trust service providers and digital services; it is the instrument itself, dated 13 March 2023.
